title: Wrap text
statementMd:
Split `text` into lines of at most `width` characters, breaking only at spaces (words longer than `width` stay alone on their line). Return the list of lines; words are separated by single spaces.

**Example:** `wrap_text("the quick brown fox", 10)` returns `["the quick", "brown fox"]`.
hints: Greedily add words while the line fits.
